purpose: C2 continuous stage, first test: each host's W2 weights (A16 baseline, H_U) with indices frozen, per-Linear log-scales on both sides, W' = diag(e^s) W diag(e^t), tuned with A + lambda Z + beta K through the imagine -> execute rollout on Q0's recipe (25921795 reader_kl: C80 once, 8 Adam updates of 10 contexts, clip 1, moments reset after update 1). Q0's codebook/gain tuning cut held-out motor 8% and future 13% from its reconstruction start; the curvature-only rounding variants (phases 1-4, gate 1) did not generalize. No action-only ablation arm in this test.
parameters: per target Linear s (out_features) and t (in_features), FP32, zero at start; the training forward uses the BF16 weight bf16(e^s W e^t), i.e. exactly the folded deployment weight; biases, norms and every other parameter frozen
storage: QTIP and QuIP# dequantize as diag(SU) H^T Q H diag(SV) * Wscale, so e^s and e^t fold into their FP16 sign/scale vectors: 0 extra bits; GPTVQ stores both vectors in FP16: +16 (out + in) bits per Linear
loss: mean over the batch of A + lambda Z + beta K with the protocol's lambda and beta, the same for every host: A first10 x 6 motor MSE, Z future NMSE over frames 1:, K soft-bin KL of the frozen BF16 reader (614 BF16 masters) reading the student future; staged as the loss-pair worker: no-grad queries -> A/Z cotangents, reader -> beta K cotangent at the future, grad replay of the same queries (bitwise check) with both

training.schedule: the loss-pair C80 schedule (8 batches of 10 contexts, sampler seed index 0)
training.update: delta = -eta g / max|g| (gradient-proportional; the scale with the largest gradient changes by eta, relative)
training.update_basis: run 26057132 (Adam, LR grid 5e-4 / 2e-3 / 8e-3): Adam's first step -lr sign(g) on all ~3M scales left the loss unchanged at 5e-4 (every folded weight rounded back to the same BF16 value: changes under half a BF16 spacing, ~0.2%, vanish) and raised it 34-69% (QTIP, QuIP#) at 2e-3; GPTVQ dropped 9% at 2e-3
training.step_rule: on batch 1 at s = t = 0: predicted decrease eta |g|^2 / max|g|, realized = L(0) - L(step) on the same batch; take the largest grid eta whose realized decrease is at least min_realized_fraction of the predicted one; no such eta -> the host is not tuned

evaluation: C80 mixed loss (A + lambda Z) of the baseline and of the folded arm on all 80 contexts; held-out 40x2 + C1 swap of the folded arm (the baseline's held-out from phases 1 and 3)

decision.rule: closed loop of the tuned arms if on at least min_hosts hosts: C80 mixed loss after < before, held-out mixed loss <= mixed_ratio_max x the baseline's, and held-out future NMSE below the baseline's

allocation.ncpus_basis: one process per host and GPU, ~2-3 busy cores each (26043905 CPU_SAMPLE); PBS sets 16 per GPU regardless
allocation.memory_basis: per process: runtime + 614 BF16 masters on the CPU (~9 GB) + reader staging
allocation.time_basis: per host: C80 fit 2 x 80 queries, LR check ~10 min, 8 updates ~6 min each (26043905: ~30 s per context with a probe backward), held-out 80 queries + swap

split.basis: 26057670 (g2, 3 GPUs) still queued after 2.8 h; a g1 one-GPU job on QTIP races it: if the g1 job starts first the 3-GPU job is cancelled and GPTVQ + QuIP# go to a g2 two-GPU job, otherwise the g1 job is cancelled; whichever split job finishes second writes the final report (run_tune.pbs)
split.outcome: the g1 job started at once and 26057670 was cancelled; QTIP ran on g1 (26059212, ~50 min); fwgt2 (26059214) then sat in g2 (node_pool), so GPTVQ and QuIP# each also race it on g1: the first start among the three decides (fwgt2 first -> qdel both g1 jobs; a g1 job first -> qdel fwgt2)

loop.purpose: Submitted only on DECISION go: LIBERO-Plus 280 of the three tuned arms; per host paired against the baseline W2, McNemar, pooled over hosts
